summary:
EarthPulse – AI-Powered Disaster Monitoring & Predictive Intelligence

EarthPulse, developed by Team CHAIRMAN for the NASA Space Apps Challenge, is an innovative disaster monitoring and predictive intelligence platform designed to make Earth observation data accessible, understandable, and useful for everyone.

We developed an interactive web application using Python and Streamlit that combines environmental data visualization, natural hazard monitoring, predictive analytics, and upcoming disaster alerts. EarthPulse focuses on major natural hazards, including earthquakes, floods, heavy rainfall, and snowfall, helping users identify potential risks and understand changing environmental conditions.

Our project addresses the challenge by transforming complex Earth science information into meaningful insights through interactive dashboards and data-driven predictions. By exploring patterns in environmental data, EarthPulse aims to support earlier awareness of potential disasters and better preparedness.

Why is it important? Natural disasters threaten millions of lives every year. Timely information and accessible technology can help communities make informed decisions, reduce risks, and improve disaster preparedness.

Our vision is simple: Predict Risks, Protect Lives, and Build a Safer Tomorrow.
details:
EarthPulse – AI-Powered Disaster Monitoring & Predictive Intelligence

EarthPulse, developed by Team CHAIRMAN, is an innovative web-based platform designed to monitor natural disasters and provide predictive insights into earthquakes, floods, heavy rainfall, and snowfall.

Our platform combines environmental data, interactive dashboards, predictive analytics, and upcoming hazard alerts to help users understand potential disaster risks and prepare for emergencies.

Technologies Used: Python, Streamlit, VS Code, data visualization tools, and predictive analytics techniques. The project is hosted online using Streamlit Community Cloud.

Innovation: EarthPulse brings multiple natural hazards into one interactive platform with modern animations, intuitive visualizations, and data-driven risk insights, making complex environmental information accessible to everyone.

Impact: Our goal is to improve disaster awareness, encourage early preparedness, and support informed decision-making. We aim to reduce the gap between complex Earth science data and everyday users.

During development, we prioritized accessibility, user experience, environmental awareness, data reliability, and scalability.

Our Vision: Predict Risks, Protect Lives, and Build a Safer Tomorrow.
